projectName: StaffTime — Workforce OS for Shopify POS
notes: MVP core features implemented: POS clock workflow, scheduling, attendance dashboard, payroll CSV export, and missed punch approvals.
Enterprise features (RBAC, GPS/photo verification, full offline sync, payroll provider integrations) remain on roadmap.
Demo employees seed on first admin visit: John PIN 1234, Sarah PIN 5678.
Competitive reference: Zon Staff Management on Shopify App Store.
